note: A hand inventory, not melian mutants output: melian mutants list sets git.ts, process-tree.ts and mutation-process.ts aside because they send signals. Mutants come from scripts/instrument-mutants.mjs; lines and columns are 1-based. Each ran against its one named test alone, which passed unmutated first. A process-tree.ts or mutation-process.ts mutant ran with no real signal: ProcessTable.kill sent none, or the supervisor's process.kill was a fake. ranAt names the head each ran at; the first pass covered the range from the base to ce4d6692, and each later pass the lines its own commits changed.
